title: Mangoh fanat yan angodda
intro: Atu isih gorrissam ummattah fanat ken qadaagah arooca tellemmol buzz, uxih ken qeedaalisso tip amaanat sinna. farmoyti qado maabitina luk keenih temeete, takkay immay oson yasuuleenim kee sinni leedal kibal lon. Qaran dattoowem qemmiseh, takkay immay oson robti barkat tet yubleenih. A mari miyyaay?
clues: Nanu kabxah baaxooxal diggalsimneeh, uxih ni sorkocô baxi qammaxxag le.
Farmoyti ni Rabbik astooti luk nee fan temeete, takkay ikkah nanu kay diggoowat anqasneh.
Nanu ninni tellemmol tamixxige, takkay immay nanu ux qeedaalisso neceeh ummatta duquurusne.
Nanu coox kee caxaaxuwi fanat mannowne, takkay immay nanu ninni barkat nek beyne.
Data qammurre xayyowte wak, nanu ruffa inne, toh rob baahele ni kafin baaxol.
Wohuk muxxi, woo qammurre girah digaala rubteeh, silal ayroh gadaamat nee tibbixe.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Oson isinni farmoyti cineeniih, tellemmol duquurusen.
oson dahabak tan ruga yubduden kee ken hoxat ken beyte .
oson soodomi gabbateenih kee safreynit maysattaka aben
Oson xer kalqatitte xiseenih Yallal gexkalooten
oson lee tabaatabsaanam cineenih is gaali biyaakeenih
trial.answer: Oson isinni farmoyta cineeniih, tellemmol duquurusen.
